description: Develop an automated churn prediction and prevention system that identifies at-risk clients using engagement scoring (already implemented), usage patterns, and subscription renewal signals. Trigger automated intervention campaigns (personalized emails, in-app prompts, exclusive offers, re-engagement galleries) before churn occurs. Include predictive modeling with historical data, churn risk scoring with explainable factors ("no gallery views in 30 days"), and A/B testing of different intervention strategies. Create admin dashboard showing at-risk client segments and intervention performance metrics.
